root_cause_of_frame93_denied: After SERVICE (054C:0336) STOP (0336:7) and object disposal (0336:8), the camera disconnected 054C:0336 and re-enumerated on the exact same physical port (locationID=0x01100000, physical_port_registryID=4294968654) as 054C:096F ('USB Bus-powered Device', USB Serial Number 'AD51109D9538', HID interface class 3). Because find_at() in iokit_adapter.c only accepts product IDs 0x0da1 (MSC) or 0x0336 (SERVICE) and returns FX3T_DENIED (1) for any other Sony PID on the target physical port, post-STOP return poll sample 7 (flow-0093.bin, sequence=94, op=63, point=2) returned status=1 (FX3T_DENIED), causing service_flow.c to enter HELD (flow-0094.bin, sequence=95).
